description: The hook command's quiet and odd paths (spec §8): nothing declared – SessionStart and the prompt (checkInterval 0: never a background sync) say nothing; no event says nothing; an unknown event is one display-safe warning line, also when `--harness` stands where the event goes; `--harness codex` with Claude Code alone in use answers as Claude Code's; --json, --scope and --project-dir are taken off the arguments as for any command (the hook goes by its environment and input), an unknown option or a --scope no command takes is no error. Every run exits 0; none reads its arguments as a reason to fail.
